content_sections.heading: NARIP Senior Research Fellow Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the NARIP Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. content_sections.text: M. Pharm (Pharmacology)/M.V.Sc (Pharmacology) / Pharmaceutical Science M.Sc (Life Science) from a recognized University. Desirable: Minimum 1 years experience in the field of animal experimentation.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit

You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: NARIP Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NARIP Senior Research Fellow (Pharmacology) recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. The interview is scheduled for 05-10-2026. Candidates should report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow (Pharmacology) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess M. Pharm (Pharmacology)/M.V.Sc (Pharmacology) / Pharmaceutical Science M.Sc (Life Science) from a recognized University. A minimum of 1 year of experience in animal experimentation is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Senior Research Fellow (Pharmacology) post is 35 years as of 01-10-2026. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow (Pharmacology) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000/- per month, plus 10% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Research Fellow (Pharmacology) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Research Fellow (Pharmacology) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the NARIP recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the NARIP Senior Research Fellow (Pharmacology) recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for General/OBC and SC/ST category candidates for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Walk-in Interview be held?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at the National Ayurveda Research Institute for Panchakarma (NARIP) located in Cheruthuruthy, Kerala, PIN Code: 679531.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Senior Research Fellow (Pharmacology) is on a contractual basis.
